Name: Kvoor's Legendary Fish Plaques Revived
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Permissions for this seemed open and someone expressed interest in the Discord the other day so...voila!

This is a simple little CP mod that adds plaques of the Legendary Fish as furniture. Now you can mount those frustrating f*****s to flaunt your victory!

Credit to Kvoor for the original mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1394]here[/url].

Enjoy!

EDIT: As of 1.0.1 it now has SVE and MNF compatibility! (I'm waiting to hear back from Raf about adding RSV compatibility and Lumi about VMV). [s]Plaques are also now available as a crafting recipe at Fishing Level 5 and will require one Legendary fish and 5 hardwood.

[/s]EDIT2: Crafting recipes have been removed as of 1.0.2 since it was pointed out it was a bit much. Now has compatibility with all the following mods:
 
-[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE
[/url]-﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3578]More New Fish
[/url]-[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]RSV
[/url]-[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mount Vapius
[/url]-[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22956]Ilucie's Legendary Fish Family II

[/url]Thank you to all the talented mod authors that gave me compat permission!
